messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: connectBluetooth
function.description: Establishes a connection to a Bluetooth device using its name. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

device_name.description: The name of the Bluetooth device to connect to.

timeout.description: The number of seconds to attempt a connection before timing out.

auto_reconnect.description: Whether to automatically attempt to reconnect if the connection is lost.

message.content:
Below is a quick‑reference list of the **federal long weekends** that Canadians enjoyed in 2023.  
(If a holiday falls on a weekend, the “observed” day is the nearest weekday, which often creates a 3‑day weekend.)

| Holiday | Calendar Date | Observed (if different) | Long‑Weekend Span | Notes |
|---------|---------------|------------------------|-------------------|-------|
| New Year’s Day | Sunday Jan 1 | Friday Jan 2 | **Fri Jan 2 – Sun Jan 4** | 3‑day weekend (holiday on Jan 2) |
| Family Day (Ontario, BC, AB, NB, PE, SK, etc.) | Monday Feb 20 | – | **Sat Feb 18 – Mon Feb 20** | 3‑day weekend |
| Good Friday | Friday Apr 7 | – | **Fri Apr 7 – Sun Apr 9** | 3‑day weekend |
| Victoria Day | Monday May 22 | – | **Sat May 20 – Mon May 22** | 3‑day weekend |
| Canada Day | Saturday Jul 1 | Friday Jun 30 | **Fri Jun 30 – Sun Jul 2** | 3‑day weekend (holiday observed Jun 30) |
| Labour Day | Monday Sep 4 | – | **Sat Sep 2 – Mon Sep 4** | 3‑day weekend |
| Thanksgiving | Monday Oct 9 | – | **Sat Oct 7 – Mon Oct 9** | 3‑day weekend |
| Remembrance Day | Saturday Nov 11 | Friday Nov 10 | **Fri Nov 10 – Sun Nov 12** | 3‑day weekend (holiday observed Nov 10) |
| Christmas Day | Monday Dec 25 | – | **Sat Dec 23 – Mon Dec 25** | 3‑day weekend |
| Boxing Day | Tuesday Dec 26 | – | – | Not a long weekend (falls on a weekday) |

> **Pro‑Tip:** Some provinces add extra holidays (e.g., St. Patrick’s Day in Ontario, St. John’s Day in Newfoundland & Labrador). If your app needs province‑specific long weekends, let me know and I can add those too.
